records.text: An anonymous TikTok creator says 40 FBI briefings mention a color of the day, and the briefing from the day of Charlie Kirk's assassination is the only one where that color is redacted.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep 1hcjQGgvxUY)

appearances.snippet: I find 40 results of different FBI briefings talking about a color of the day. And every single one is unredacted. You can see what the color of the day was for that day for whatever military. ... on the day of charlie kirk's assassination the morning of before his death they established a color of the day for a sit rep which is just a military situation report and the color of the day is redacted ... Out of 40 different files mentioning the color of the day for secret operations, ... the day of Charlie Kirk's assassination is the only one that has a color of the day redacted.

verification.notes: The anonymous creator's underlying document claim is directly contradicted by the disclosed FBI New York email: the September 10, 2025 color of the day is readable as Yellow, not uniquely redacted. The DOJ library identifies the disclosure corpus containing the record.

sources.title: EFTA00163863 extracted FBI email
sources.relevance: Displays the disclosed FBI email stating Yellow was the color of the day for September 10, 2025.
